introHtml: Clear badge reels offer a sleek, professional look that blends with any uniform or lanyard color. Perfect for security teams, corporate offices, or events where a low-profile design is key. The transparent casing allows your logo or message to stand out without competing with the reel itself. Choose from retractable or fixed styles, and add full-color imprinting for maximum brand exposure.
